definitions.gloss: to relearn; to study again (from the start)
definitions.explanation: To go back and study a subject again, often as an adult, to fill gaps or update one's skills.

examples.japanese: ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{学|まな}び{直|なお}す。
⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧になって⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{学|まな}び{直|なお}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I've been studying math again since becoming an adult.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{続|つづ}け⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{学|まな}び{直|なお}す⟦{社会人|しゃかいじん}→社会人：13730_shakaijin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More and more working people are going back to university to study while keeping their jobs.

notes:
⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧ (to study) + 〜{直|なお}す (to do again).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{学|まな}び{直|なお}す

FORMS:
- {学|まな}び{直|なお}し: relearning; adult re-education, a common policy and media term

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{学|まな}び{直|なお}す: to relearn from scratch
- ⟦{基礎|きそ}→基礎：03981_kiso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{学|まな}び{直|なお}す: to go back over the basics
- ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{学|まな}び{直|なお}す: to go back to university
